title: ottonia baptisiana
intro: Ottonia baptisiana, commonly known as Tonka bean, is a perennial plant native to Central and South America. It is valued for its aromatic seeds, which contain a volatile oil that has been used for centuries in traditional medicine. Tonka bean seeds have been reported to exhibit several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential therapeutic agent for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Tonka bean seeds include coumarin, which is responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic actions.
